Check whether a number is prime in an optimised way (up to the square root).

Supplied answer
num = int(input("Enter a number: "))
if num <= 1:
    print("Not prime")
else:
    is_prime = True
    for i in range(2, int(num ** 0.5) + 1):
        if num % i == 0:
            is_prime = False
            break
    print("Prime" if is_prime else "Not prime")
Note: Checking only up to sqrt(n) reduces the work from O(n) to O(sqrt n). Say this in interviews.
